desc:
✨ Welcome to Bo's Difficulty Chart Obby 2! ✨ 
This obby starts off easy but will get more difficult as you progress. How far can you go?

✅ All 180 stages are proven possible. Only 0.1% of players have what it takes to beat the game! 

💰 Collect coins and rebirth to unlock epic halos, titles, trails, and more!
🏃 Race friends in timed speedruns and become the best!
🏅 Grind to the top of the leaderboards!
⛈️ Survive unique in-game events that spawn every 30 minutes!
⚙️ Customize your in-game settings for a better experience! 

⭐ Enjoying the game? Drop a favorite for more updates!
🎁 LIKE the game and join the Bo Studios group for a FREE skip stage!

Use R to Reset quicker when falling!
Use <> for Alignment Keys when Wall Hopping!

🎟️ Use code 100KVISITS for a free skip!
